name: hazel_weir_velocity_procedural_graph
description: Optimized Procedural Graph featuring a Day 3 Strawberry compounding shift, 22-24 plot workforce-synchronized land scaling frozen at Day 13, 14-item liquidation buffers for 2.0x-3.5x town shop arbitrage, opportunistic backpack drop-offs, and synchronized terminal liquidation across steps 706-718.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, active shop contract demand, total plot count, contiguous layout metrics, and oracle price drop signals across market commodities.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces dynamic cash reserve locks after hour 18 and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation with true livestock-scaled feed reserves (n_animals * 3) to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Fulfills active town shop contracts for 2.0x-3.5x premiums. Prioritizes existing shed inventory and rapid Carrots (max 2 plots) while strictly barring slow single-harvest crops after Day 3, ensuring >= 90% of land compounds hyper-fertilized Strawberries.

nodes.name: Capital Velocity & Liquidation
nodes.description: Abolishes shed hoarding by executing continuous batch liquidations of uncontracted surplus at dynamic price floors (>= 0.84x base normal; >= 0.78x midday hours 10-16 on expansion days <= 13 or when shed fullness >= 60%), preserving crop margins on recurring flushes.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Reads 96-step TTM forecast to dump sensitive commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) only when glut risk is acute (risk >= 0.52, price >= 0.82x base) before opponent dumping collapses market prices.

nodes.name: Capital Reinvestment & Yield Scaling
nodes.description: Reinvests surplus cash into synchronized workforce and land scaling (8-10 plots by Day 4-5 with 3-4 hands; 14-16 plots by Day 8 with 6-7 hands; 20-24 contiguous plots by Day 12-13 with 10-11 hands; hard land freeze at Day 13), decoupling daytime reinvestment (1.0x payroll) to accelerate hyper-fertilized Strawberry compounding with a Day 22 procurement cutoff.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes field routines with strict micro-dispatch sequencing: in-situ harvest-and-water recurring crops, soil preparation and pre-seed hyper-fertilization, cluster harvesting up to backpack capacity, cluster watering, shed drop-off, livestock feeding, and planting.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases; schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21; enforce emergency liquidation of unreserved, non-shop surplus inventory starting at hour 20 to guarantee payroll before midnight.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 3); never hoard phantom wheat when n_animals == 0; never liquidate crops committed to active town shop delivery; do not trigger emergency liquidation before hour 18 during normal daytime production.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and (shop_deliverable_inventory > 0 or (net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.25 + 50.0 and active_shop_demand > 0 and day <= 22)) and day <= 30
attributes.guidance: Allocate market slots to deliver exact matching inventory to town shops for 2.0x-3.5x premium through step 710. Fulfill orders immediately from existing shed inventory (including Strawberries, Milk, Wool, Carrots). Strictly condition seed procurement on: 1) day + crop_growth_days <= 28; 2) no slow single-harvest crops (Pumpkin, Tomato, Cauliflower, Potato) after Day 3; 3) cap rapid Carrot shop acreage to at most 2 plots, preserving >= 90% acreage for hyper-fertilized Strawberries; 4) hard seed procurement cutoff at Day 22 to ban endgame Carrot backfills.
attributes.pitfalls: Never purchase or plant slow crops (Pumpkin, Tomato, Potato, Cauliflower) after Day 3, as they cannibalize high-yielding Strawberry flushes for a minor one-off premium. Do not completely abandon fast Carrot shop fulfillment or shed arbitrage, as that forfeits lucrative 2.0x-3.5x premiums to opponents. Never buy shop seeds if net available cash is below 1.25x midnight payroll. Do not hoard uncontracted surplus speculatively beyond the 14-item buffer.

attributes.guidance: Execute batch sales of unreserved, non-shop surplus holdings at dynamic price floors: maintain >= 0.84x base price during standard operations (shed < 60%). Permit sales down to 0.78x base price during midday reinvestment windows (hours 10-16) strictly on expansion days <= 13 to unlock fluid capital, or when shed fullness exceeds 60%. Defend a strict minimum liquidation floor of 0.82x base on mature compounding days (Day 14-28). Conduct progressive terminal shed clearances strictly between steps 706-718 at a defended >= 0.72x floor.
attributes.pitfalls: Never dump bulk Strawberry harvests at sub-0.82x base price after Day 13 unless shed fullness exceeds 85%. Never liquidate Wheat below dynamic feed reserve (n_animals * 3). Never liquidate exact item quotas reserved for active town shop contracts. Avoid premature terminal fire-sales before step 706.

attributes.guidance: Preempt lowest-margin open orders; execute rapid batch liquidations of vulnerable commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) only when oracle_glut_risk >= 0.52 and current_price >= 0.82 * base_price before opponent dumping collapses market prices.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not front-run on hypersensitive or weak glut signals (risk < 0.52); never dump into collapsed sub-0.82 base price markets unless shed overflow is imminent; do not front-run commodities committed to active town shop contracts.

attributes.condition: ((hour < 18 and net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.0 + 50.0) or (hour >= 18 and net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.5 + 100.0)) and (hired_hands < 11 or (total_plots < 24 and day <= 13) or uncultivated_plots > 0 or has_fertilizer_deficit) and day <= 22
attributes.guidance: Scale workforce dynamically alongside contiguous land across three waves: reach 8-10 plots and 3-4 hands by Day 4-5, expanding to 14-16 plots and 6-7 hands by Day 8, and reaching 20-24 contiguous plots and 10-11 hands by Day 12-13 (~2.0-2.2 plots/hand). Enforce a hard land expansion freeze at Day 13. Decouple daytime reinvestment between hours 04:00-17:00 by requiring only 1.0x payroll reserve + action cost. Compress Carrots to a strict single-cycle bootstrap (harvested Day 3), transitioning all plots immediately on Days 3-4 into hyper-fertilized Strawberries to secure 7-8 lifetime recurring flushes per plot. Enforce a hard Strawberry seed and fertilizer procurement cutoff at Day 22.
attributes.pitfalls: Never purchase plots after Day 13 as late land expansion yields negative ROI. Never expand land when cash is below daytime reserve (1.0x payroll + plot cost before hour 18, 1.5x after hour 18). Never purchase Strawberry seeds or fertilizer after Day 22, dedicating all late-game labor to Strawberry maintenance. Do not plant slow single-harvest crops on expanding acreage.

attributes.guidance: Dispatch hands following strict micro-dispatch priority: 1) In-situ Harvest & Immediate Water recurring crops (workers harvesting ripe Strawberry plots immediately water the plot in-situ if carrying water and plot is dry before departing), 2) Soil Preparation & Pre-Seed Hyper-Fertilization (apply fertilizer to tilled soil before seeding to ensure all Strawberries are hyper-fertilized), 3) Cluster Harvest adjacent ripe plots (immediate harvesting without pre-harvest well detours), 4) Cluster Watering of any remaining dry cultivated plots to eliminate regrowth halts, 5) Shed Drop-off (opportunistic drop-offs when carrying >= 6 items, transitioning task zones, or hour >= 20; guarantee all carried goods deposited by step 718), 6) Livestock Feeding, 7) Planting seeds (hyper-fertilized Strawberries primary; max 2 Carrot plots for active shops), 8) Till/Weed new plots.
attributes.pitfalls: Never allow Strawberry plots to remain unwatered post-harvest, as dry intervals freeze regrowth clocks. Never plant Strawberry seeds on unfertilized plots; always apply fertilizer prior to seed placement. Do not force pre-harvest well detours; harvest immediately and water in-situ if equipped. Do not hoard items in backpacks; utilize opportunistic drop-offs (>= 6 items or zone transitions) to accelerate reinvestment velocity. Never create dispatch deadlocks if an action cannot be performed immediately; gracefully fall through priority chain. Ensure no hand idles while harvestable crops or dry plots exist.
